# Cloudflare custom rules

Paste each expression into **Security > WAF > Custom rules > Create rule > Edit expression** and pick the action shown.
The address rule needs an IP list named `td_agentic_attack_ips` first: **Manage Account > Configurations > Lists**, then import the addresses from `ip-list.json` (see the README).

On the Free plan (5 custom rules) create the five rules marked *on by default*. The others need Enterprise (log action, body inspection) or only fit some sites.

## Agentic framework user agents

- Action: `block`, on by default
- Rule reference: `td_framework_user_agents`

```
(lower(http.user_agent) contains "artex-readonly/" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "artex-pentest/" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "artex-audit/" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "artex-verify/" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "artex-spawn/" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "artex-enrich/" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "artex-worker/" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "artex-i21861-canary" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "artex-authorized-pentest" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "mozilla/5.0 artex" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "mozilla/5.0 (artex)" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "scopeweaver" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "spa-api-recon" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "antifox-enrich/" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "hexstrike-http-framework/" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "hexstrike-browseragent/" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "cyberstrikeai-webshell/" or http.user_agent contains "ArtExVerify/1.0" or http.user_agent contains "ArtEx/1.0" or starts_with(http.user_agent, "CyberStrikeAI/") or starts_with(http.user_agent, "artex-agent") or starts_with(http.user_agent, "artex-judge-"))
```

## Framework probe markers in the URL and framework request headers

- Action: `block`, on by default
- Rule reference: `td_probe_markers`

```
(lower(http.request.uri) contains "zzz-nonexistent-xyz123" or lower(http.request.uri) contains "zzz_nonexistent_abc.txt" or lower(http.request.uri) contains "notexist-xyz" or lower(http.request.uri) contains "artex_write_probe" or lower(http.request.uri) contains "artx_persist_ok" or lower(http.request.uri) contains "artex_control_marker_zz9q" or lower(http.request.uri) contains "artex-probe-" or lower(http.request.uri) contains "code=aaaa&state=notvalidb64!!" or lower(http.request.uri) contains "code=aaaa&state=notvalidb64%21%21" or lower(http.request.uri) contains "hexstrikexsstest123" or lower(http.request.uri) contains "osprobe_" or lower(http.request.uri) contains "osprobe%5f" or any(lower(http.request.headers.names[*])[*] == "x-artx-key") or any(lower(http.request.headers.names[*])[*] == "x-artex-replay-nonce"))
```

## Unsigned alg none JWT in the URL or Authorization header

- Action: `block`, on by default
- Rule reference: `td_jwt_alg_none`
- Blocks every unsigned token, whoever sends it. If one of your applications accepts unsigned JWTs by design, keep this rule in log or count.

```
(http.request.uri contains "eyJhbGciOiJub25lI" or http.request.uri contains "eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJub25lI" or http.request.uri contains "eyJhbGciOiJOb25lI" or http.request.uri contains "eyJhbGciOiJOT05FI" or any(http.request.headers["authorization"][*] contains "eyJhbGciOiJub25lI") or any(http.request.headers["authorization"][*] contains "eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJub25lI") or any(http.request.headers["authorization"][*] contains "eyJhbGciOiJOb25lI") or any(http.request.headers["authorization"][*] contains "eyJhbGciOiJOT05FI"))
```

## CyberStrikeAI webshell OS probe in the request body

- Action: `block`, off by default
- Rule reference: `td_webshell_probe_body`
- Body inspection. On Cloudflare it needs an Enterprise plan with Advanced application security, so the rule ships disabled there.

```
http.request.body.raw contains "OSPROBE_"
```

## Attack tool user agents seen with agentic frameworks (medium confidence)

- Action: `managed_challenge`, on by default
- Rule reference: `td_scanner_user_agents`

```
(lower(http.user_agent) contains "fuzz faster u fool v2.1.0-dev" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "mozilla/5.0 (compatible exploit)" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "reconprobe/1.0" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "norma/0.4" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "azure-toolkit/1.0")
```

## Addresses reported in agentic framework intrusions (low and medium confidence)

- Action: `managed_challenge`, on by default
- Rule reference: `td_reported_addresses`
- Hosting addresses get reused, so these are never blocked by default. Expired rows (review_by before as_of) are left out.

```
ip.src in $td_agentic_attack_ips
```

## AI agent page readers (also legitimate use)

- Action: `log`, off by default
- Rule reference: `td_ai_agent_readers`
- People use these agents for real work. Log them so the SIEM hunt that pairs a page reader with attack traffic from the same address can run. Never block by default.

```
(http.user_agent contains "Claude-User (claude-code/" or starts_with(http.user_agent, "QwenCode/") or starts_with(http.user_agent, "KimiCLI/") or starts_with(http.user_agent, "opencode/") or starts_with(http.user_agent, "agent-zero/"))
```

## Hermes results folder requested

- Action: `log`, off by default
- Rule reference: `td_hermes_results_path`

```
http.request.uri contains "/hermes-results/"
```

## WSUS administration and sync web services requested from the internet

- Action: `block`, off by default
- Rule reference: `td_wsus_from_internet`
- Turn on for sites that front a WSUS server. These services should never be reachable from the internet.

```
(lower(http.request.uri) contains "/apiremoting30/webservice.asmx" or lower(http.request.uri) contains "/serversyncwebservice/serversyncwebservice.asmx" or lower(http.request.uri) contains "/reportingwebservice/reportingwebservice.asmx")
```
